mining_skiff.name: Mining Skiff
mining_skiff.description: A lumbering belt-runner built almost entirely around its hold - built to take a few knocks from the rock it's chewing through, but no racer.

raider_skiff.name: Raider Skiff
raider_skiff.description: A stripped-down pirate interceptor - fast off the line, but the hull folds the moment anyone shoots back.
